description: This PHP class defines a report display field related to 'Education' within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a listable display field class and provides specific configurations like Data Transfer Object (DTO) class, entity alias, and fields relevant for reporting purposes.

classes.name: Education
classes.description: Represents a report display field for education-related data in the OrangeHRM system, providing configuration for DTO class, entity alias, and specific fields for reporting purposes.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object used for education data in reports.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the aliases used for the education entity in query generation.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields related to employee education that are included in the report.
